reviews.t: highly versatile, well made, effective shower cap. Fits my large head, and all my hair
reviews.x: An adorable shower cap that fits my large head. It says it fits up to 24" head, and mine measures 23.5". Then I have loads of hair- semi thick, nearly waist length. It all fits! Yet isn't a big bulbous excess of material either. But I am definitely pushing max space available (again, I have a large head).  I simply dont wash my hair every day, but I do hop in the shower. I dont notice my hair getting wet at all, but I dont put my head in the water even with this on. I have a spray nozzle for was

I bought this shower cap to wear at the Blue Lagoon in Iceland since I wanted a cap that would look cute in pictures. I’d say mission accomplished. The cap kept the sulfuric water out of my hair- I’d read that when the water gets into your hair it leaves your hair crunchy and dry for weeks. I didn’t have that problem since this cap was water right. Highly recommend

I was looking for a shower cap that wasn't flimsy or hair-eating (I have mid-back length hair and showering very often results in a wet ponytail that takes forever to dry). This cap is very comfortable, I like the pattern (it's not immediately apparent that it's shower-related) and it looks very well made: over-locked edges, a not-slip trip along the forehead and a sassy bow on the side. The fabric is velvety-soft on the outside, very pleasing to the touch, and waterproof on the inside, but it d

reviews.t: I feel like a grown woman now
reviews.x: This is the best and most stylish shower cap I have ever owned. I feel like a real adult now lol. So cute. I want to send one to all the ladies in my family to up their shower game!

This is the nicest shower cap I’ve ever had. I finally found an eco-friendly alternative to disposable shower caps. The material is soft to touch, feels very nice and fits perfectly. So far, the quality looks great, I hope it will last me for years. Thank you!
Looks goofy as heck on me, but serves the purpose I bought it for, to shower but keep hair dry. Good material & well made

reviews.t: Glad I chose this shower cap.
reviews.x: So cute! Fits perfectly. Does the job wonderfully.
Very functional and well made. It’s as cute a shower cap as possible. Pretty print and fits very well.

The color and pattern is very beautiful and vibrant and just as shown in the picture. It works perfectly and I love that the material dries very quickly so the next day is not damp at all.  I've been using it for a while now and it hasn't stretched a lot. Other caps I had became very loose after a few uses, this one is still working just as if it was new

It seems like very good quality and what I like most about it is it’s flattering unlike most shower caps.  It’s a little pricey and I wish there were different fabric options, but I think it will last me several years and on that scale it’s well worth it.

I have a relatively small head circumference, so I purchased this shower cap in March 2022 in hopes that this design would offer a better water seal and less gaps that get my hair wet in the water. I specifically thought the bow on the front would tighten to constrict the cap a bit. Well.  I’m writing this review in June 2022, after 3 months of typical wear, to report that the front half of the elastic band has come unglued and hangs across my forehead unless I tuck it up in the cap with my hair

I was really excited about this product because it was adorable... unfortunately, that is one of the only positive things I can say about it. It is super cute and very stretchy - but it doesn’t work. I placed my hair in a knot at the nape of my neck as suggested, made sure the elastic was below my hairline, and tied the front tight, hopped in the shower, and... the entire underside of my hair is soaked.  I guess it depends on what you are purchasing for. If you are purchasing to keep you hair ou
This is worth every penny. The fit is snug but not too tight. Keeps my hair dry and looks cute but in a way that suites a more mature woman like myself. I will definitely be purchasing another.

Likes: The cap fits my hair when I wear it with my natural hair and with my braids I get done. I like that it also fits my toddler who is 3 because she has an issue wearing the ones I get her. She likes this one because of the design and the way it fits her head because it doesn't fall off or isn't too tight for her. The cap is thick and holds strong. The style is super cute too.  Dislikes: The cap is a little bit tight when I put it on.  I would really recommend this product for anyone looking

reviews.t: When cap shopping look for proper band size and a smaller overall “pouf”
reviews.x: Luckily this was only my third cap purchase and like Goldilocks the third one was just right. I have a fairly large head with hair past my shoulder blades. I’ve found the poufy part on a lot of shower caps is much too generous and therefore tends to flop around and pull the band away from my head, annoyingly letting water in exactly where I don’t want it. We really don’t need much room up there if our hair is gathered properly at our nape, as instructed. What we DO need is a proper band size to

The cap is SO cute, but it's small and the elastic isn't tight enough to keep water out. My head fits but just barely, and I don't consider myself to have a large head at all.  I also normally wear a scarf or 2 underneath any shower cap to keep my silk press/straight hair from being ruined. Unfortunately this cap is def too small for that. Without a scarf yes it fits, but it's tight (in a too small way) + the elastic isn't that tight. With those factors combined I felt like any sudden movement i

Alright... let’s be real for a moment. I’ve been married for a long time. I truly don’t care how cute I look while showering anymore. (Haha!) However, this is the cutest shower cap I’ve ever owned!  I have a lot of hair, and it fits my hair in a low pony or mid bun. It’s not quite big enough for a high pony, which is ok! None usually are.  The color is beautiful. I love the pattern and it seems to be well made. I appreciate the elastic is tight without cutting off my circulation. I’m a sucker fo

This shower cap works!  And it is easy to get on plus the non-slip strip works to keep it in its place and not slipping down on my face.  My hair stays dry!  (I have a keratin treatment and with that, it is best not to wash one's hair every day - so I had to find a shower cap that worked!)

Bought this for my elderly mom (85). She complained about the grip on her forehead. Personally, I love it and use it. No water gets in, unlike a traditional shower cap. And it’s pretty.  I think that on her more delicate skin, it was not the right product for her.

reviews.t: For my girls with BIG hair :)
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:ab7c8dd7ca2425e89583340b5c1d9f8a]] I love this shower turban! I feel like every time I purchase a shower cap, it doesn’t fit all of my hair! So frustrating. This shower turban holds all of my hair & is nice & snug. No steam getting in here! Super happy!
It feels sturdy and is very water resistant. It seems that it would fit nicely with my natural hair, however, it is not as large as I like for my braids. But overall good product.

reviews.t: Cute and all but small if you have a large head like me
reviews.x: My head is a little bigger than average I know, but I have very very short hair so I thought it would work as I do not stretch it to the back with a hair bun or anything. It is so so tight , which might be good for stopping leaks underneath, it gives me a headache. I can’t enjoy the bathtub time.  So if you know your head size is average that you normally do not have problem when buying hats or glasses, it would be great for you. Very stylish.

I have a LOT of long, crazy curly hair. (See photo for reference) this shower cap actually holds it all really well. The elastic band is thick and very effective at keeping water out. The colors are STUNNING!!! My BF commented about how cute I looked with my shower cap. I will definitely be using this in between wash days to preserve my curls.

Mine -just- fits and my head isn't that large. I put my long hair up with a scrunchie and it all gets covered. I don't think this would work for someone with super long hair. It's so cute my hubby thought I bought a new hat and that I was going to wear it out to an event the night it arrived.
I loved this item when I first got it, but after a couple months of using it the elastic along the front of the cap has come off and the cap is not as useful.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the cap's cute, stylish appearance and attractive patterns.
Many customers say it fits well and accommodates long or thick hair, though some with smaller heads report fit issues.
The cap is widely described as well made and good quality, with material that dries quickly and holds up over time.
Most reviewers report it effectively keeps hair dry, but a few say it fails to provide a proper water seal.
A few customers mention it is a bit pricey or wish for more fabric options, while still considering it worth the cost.
